# Append Note

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Appends text to the end of a note.

## Syntax

~~~~text
appendNote(text: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, note: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
appendNote(text: "Make sure to join the Jellycuts discord at https://jellycuts.com", note: to-do)
~~~~
